happyPath.summary: Fresh-session replay (dasomel/openforge#54, 2026-10-05) activated the skill from AGENTS.md/description for a component image bump and followed workflow step 3: a scratch curl 8.21.0 -> 8.22.0 bump applied coherently to VERSIONS.md, 4 chart templates, 4 tests and the EN/KO asset inventory. scripts/ci/check-version-consistency.py exited 0; the scratch change was reverted.

edgeCase.summary: Bumped curlimages/curl in only one manifest (01-seaweedfs.yaml), breaking the VERSIONS.md single-source invariant. The repository's own check scripts/ci/check-version-consistency.py failed with exit 1 (MISMATCH, expected 8.21.0 found 8.21.0, 8.22.0); after git checkout it exited 0 again.

unverified: No live Beluga cluster was used: isolated kubeconfig creation (step 2), ArgoCD selfHeal revert of an ad-hoc apply (step 4), a real ConfigMap rollout restart (step 6) and direct plus domain-registry entry-path measurement for a gateway/auth change (step 8) were not exercised.
make test / tests/*.sh live-cluster scripts were not run.
Local helm was v4.3.0 while CI pins v3.16.4; render results were not re-run on the CI pin.
AGENTS.md repeats the same cluster-discipline rules, so the skill's causal contribution beyond AGENTS.md is not isolated.
